notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Make infrastructure-cost context useful to the right buyer.
intro: A proposed AI-growth workbench for Vantage: connect sourced cloud and AI context to a specific FinOps question, a reviewed campaign proposal and measurable agent quality.
queueIntro: All companies, technology contexts and costs are synthetic. No cloud accounts, billing exports, private infrastructure or savings-plan purchases are accessed.
workbenchIntro: Review the buyer, evidence and proposed action before a campaign handoff. The demo does not infer private spend or make a cost-saving guarantee.
firstBuild: A FinOps research brief with an evaluation scorecard
firstBody: Link a grounded infrastructure question to engineering and finance roles, then measure factual quality, reviewer acceptance and operating cost for each proposed workflow.

fields.label: Engineering, finance and FinOps roles distinguished
Cloud or AI stack context has a current source
Product signal joined to the correct business account
Campaign proposal has a named reviewer and exact scope
Agent quality and operating cost are measured together

rules.title: Map the infrastructure-cost buying group
rules.next: A developer’s allocation task and a finance leader’s forecast question need different context and next steps.

rules.title: Ground the infrastructure context
rules.next: Record public or discovery-supported technology context. Do not infer private usage or spend from a logo list.

rules.title: Write a useful FinOps discovery question
rules.next: Ask about allocation, governance or forecasting rather than promising savings without a baseline.

rules.title: Validate the account-level signal
rules.next: Distinguish test workspaces and individual exploration from a company evaluation.

rules.title: Prepare the reviewed campaign proposal
rules.next: Attach the audience, asset and destination. A high quality score alone is not approval to launch.

rules.title: Define the evaluation contract
rules.next: Track factual errors, acceptance, retries and operating cost per useful result alongside pipeline outcomes.

ready.title: Ready for a FinOps growth review
ready.next: The reviewer can inspect the account evidence, buyer question and campaign scope. Real infrastructure cost and achievable savings require separate customer evidence.

experiments.name: Buyer-specific FinOps context
experiments.hypothesis: A clear allocation or governance question improves discovery relevance.
experiments.treatment: Sourced stack context and role-specific question
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Quality-adjusted agent evaluation
experiments.hypothesis: Cost per accepted output is more useful than cost per generated draft.
experiments.treatment: Acceptance, factual errors, retries and useful-output cost
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Map the growth system and buyer questions
roadmap.body: Work with Marketing, Sales and RevOps on current agents, account signals and FinOps discovery needs.
roadmap.measure: Known workflow owners and quality baseline

roadmap.title: Pilot one grounded research agent
roadmap.body: Build evidence-linked proposals with account resolution and explicit review. Instrument factual errors and operating cost.
roadmap.measure: Accepted outputs and cost per useful proposal

roadmap.title: Connect quality to pipeline learning
roadmap.body: Compare account cohorts through qualified conversations, refine the model and document monitoring and recovery.
roadmap.measure: Qualified pipeline, reliability and sustainable operating cost

records.name: Alder Cloud
records.context: A fictional team is reviewing allocation of cloud and AI costs across products.
records.question: How are shared costs assigned to the teams that use them?

records.name: Cedar Platform
records.context: The brief targets a developer with an executive budget-governance pitch.
records.question: Which role and decision should the message support?

records.name: Willow AI
records.context: The technology list was inferred without a current source.
records.question: Which stack details are verified and what remains unknown?

records.name: Elm Data
records.context: The message promises a percentage saving without a baseline.
records.question: What neutral allocation or forecasting question could replace it?

records.name: Birch Systems
records.context: A test workspace was scored as a business evaluation.
records.question: Which organization actually owns this activity?

records.name: Juniper Engineering
records.context: The agent is measured only by output volume and token cost.
records.question: How will useful, accurate proposals and retries be evaluated?

metricsTitle: Measure the cost of useful work, not just generated work.
metricsIntro: Illustrative agent-evaluation cohorts; costs exclude human review and are not provider pricing.
metricsNotes: All costs and outcomes are synthetic examples, not Vantage results or guaranteed infrastructure savings.
Include reviewer effort, retry cost and factual-error categories before comparing approaches.
A cheap draft that invents spend or misidentifies the buyer is not a useful outcome.
